title: 🚀 WE’RE HIRING: FRONTEND / UI ENGINEER
description:
🚀 WE’RE HIRING: FRONTEND / UI ENGINEER
Build challenging coding tasks that connect visual design with real-world frontend engineering.
We’re looking for experienced frontend developers to create technically accurate, verifiable coding challenges using visual references and working implementations.
📍 Role Details
• 🌍 Global | Fully Remote
• Contract: Project-based contractor
• Compensation: $80–$100/hour equivalent
• Payment: Approximately $640–$800 per approved task
• Estimated task duration: 8 hours
• Openings: 50
🎯 The Opportunity
Contribute your frontend expertise to building complex coding tasks with objective evaluation criteria and reliable technical solutions.
💼 What You’ll Do
• Transform screenshots, diagrams, and videos into coding challenges.
• Design multi-step tasks based on real UI workflows.
• Define technical requirements and expected application behavior.
• Establish measurable, objective success criteria.
• Develop working reference implementations.
• Review contributions for accuracy and technical quality.
• Identify ambiguous or unverifiable tasks.
🎓 What You’ll Bring
• Strong React, TypeScript, or comparable frontend experience.
• Public GitHub profile with substantial, verifiable contributions.
• Proven ability to develop and debug complex interfaces.
• Experience with UI design, graphics, SVG, or Canvas.
• Ability to validate application code and functionality.
• Strong written English and technical communication.
• Experience with AI evaluation or data labeling is advantageous.
📩 Ready to put your frontend expertise to work? Apply today!
Application link: [https://lnkd.in/ezHuBRnB]
